tasks.label: Start MySQL
tasks.command: if (-not (Test-NetConnection 127.0.0.1 -Port 3306 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue).TcpTestSucceeded) { Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File','${workspaceFolder}\scripts\start-mysql.ps1' -WindowStyle Minimized; Start-Sleep -Seconds 6 }; 'MySQL ready'
